I got an email saying my membership is renewing. When does it actually charge?
To check when your membership renewal charges, I need to verify your account first.
Please give me your full name and one of the following: your account number, your service address, or your phone number.
Raj Rivera, 6599 Cedar Ridge Ln, Buda.
Thanks, Raj.
Your Comfort Club Standard membership renews on 26 December 2026 at $189.00 a year, which is the current published price.
The account facts don't give a specific time of day for the charge, so I can't say more about timing than that date.
And I can still cancel before then?
Yes.

Per the Comfort Club Maintenance Plan overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md, Cancellation), members may cancel auto-renewal at any time before the renewal date, which for you is 26 December 2026.

The same document says annual plans are non-refundable once a tune-up has been performed in the current term, and that a prorated refund is available within the first 60 days if no tune-up has been performed.
It doesn't say whether either of those applies to your account.
